disclaimer: Automated QA only. Automated QA does NOT constitute clinical approval.

checks.check: Every candidate claim references a known source
Every claim has a non-empty exact excerpt and locator
Every claim is marked mechanically extracted / abstract_only
DOI (when present) is well-formed; every source has an identifier
No Crohn's-only record was labelled ulcerative_colitis
Applicability labels are constrained to the allowed set (no ad-hoc upgrade)
No full-text file archived without an established licence
All human/clinical review fields blank; nothing approved
No duplicate source or claim ids
Checkpoint records an exact next operation
No secret / token / connection-string pattern in outputs
No Reddit URL / handle in any output
No candidate claim is attached to a trial registry source (trials are never treatment-effect claims)
Every source's evidenceType (when present) is one of the four separate evidence types
No PDF link or downloaded-file field is stored on any source
Every extracted claim is flagged as requiring full-text verification
